results.title: PT Bhineka Inovasi Ketahanan Energi Tbk (BIKE) signs MoU to revitalize Pasar Minggu with Rp1 trillion investment
results.body: PT Bhineka Inovasi Ketahanan Energi Tbk (BIKE) has signed a memorandum of understanding with Perumda Pasar Jaya to develop and revitalize the Pasar Minggu area in South Jakarta. The MoU was executed by BIKE’s subsidiary PT Ratu Karya and outlines a project valued at approximately Rp1 trillion, featuring modern facilities such as kiosks, UMKM stalls, residential units, office buildings, a shopping centre and a food court. Following the announcement, BIKE’s shares surged 16.49% over the past week and 121.57% over the past month, and BEI suspended trading of the stock, a move triggered by the price surge. Further implementation will depend on technical, legal, commercial, financial, licensing, corporate approvals and compliance with applicable regulations.

results.title: BEI suspends trading of six stocks owned by Haji Isam and PT Danantara Aset Management, including PT Dana Brata Luhur Tbk (TEBE) and PT Wijaya Karya (Persero) Tbk (WIKA).
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) announced that trading of six stocks will be suspended effective 21 September 2026. The suspended issuers are PT Semacom Integrated Tbk (SEMA), PT Dana Brata Luhur Tbk (TEBE), PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk (IDEA), PT Charnic Capital Tbk (NICK), PT Wijaya Karya (Persero) Tbk (WIKA), and PT Bhineka Inovasi Ketahanan Energi Tbk (BIKE). Five stocks were halted for cumulative price jumps—approximately 100% in a month for SEMA, IDEA, NICK and BIKE, and a 95.31% rise over three months for TEBE—while WIKA was suspended due to business‑continuity concerns, a step that follows its earlier suspension since February 2025; PT Dana Brata Luhur Tbk (TEBE) is owned by Haji Isam and the other five issuers are under the control of PT Danantara Aset Management. BEI urged investors to review the issuers’ information disclosures for further details.

results.title: Today's Stock Recommendations: ANTM, VKTR, and MAPI
results.body: The article recommends buying ANTM, VKTR, and MAPI while noting that the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 6,441.16, down 0.33% on 18 September 2026, with foreign investors net selling about Rp1.79 trillion. It points out that the technology sector was the only sector to gain (+0.27%) as most other sectors weakened, and that FTSE rebalancing triggered the largest net sell since 19 June, affecting micro‑cap stocks BSDE, SCMA and BBYB. Corporate updates include ERAA’s plan to expand its food‑and‑beverage portfolio through its subsidiary Erajaya Food & Nourishment (EFN), BIKE’s subsidiary Ratu Karya signing a MoU with Perumda Pasar Jaya for a Rp1 trillion Pasar Minggu development, and ULTJ’s rights issue to fund the acquisition of 100 % of Frisian Flag Indonesia for Rp14.57 trillion, after which FrieslandCampina International Holding B.V. (FCIH) will become the controlling shareholder. The rights issue will issue up to 7.88 billion new shares at Rp2,150 each, representing 43.11 % of post‑issue capital and raising up to Rp16.94 trillion, with the transaction valued at 178.24 % of ULTJ’s equity and pending approval at the RUPSLB on 27 October 2026.

results.title: Bhineka Inovasi Ketahanan Energi (BIKE) Secures Rp1 trillion Pasar Minggu Project, Shares Reach Upper Auto Reject Level
results.body: Bhineka Inovasi Ketahanan Energi (BIKE) secured a Rp1 trillion Pasar Minggu development project, with its subsidiary Ratu Karya signing a memorandum of understanding with PD Pasar Jaya. BIKE’s shares rose to the Upper Auto Reject (ARA) level at Rp1,130 per share, a gain of roughly 565 % since its IPO price of Rp170 in March 2022 and over 126 % in the past month. BIKE now has a market capitalization of about Rp1.46 trillion, while reporting a semester I 2026 loss of Rp33.38 billion and a profit of Rp6.54 billion for the period. Net sales fell 30.27 % to Rp121.16 billion year-on-year, and cost of goods sold declined to Rp133.97 billion.

results.title: PT Bhineka Inovasi Ketahanan Energi Tbk (BIKE) partners with Perumda Pasar Jaya on a Rp1 trillion Pasar Minggu development
results.body: PT Bhineka Inovasi Ketahanan Energi Tbk (BIKE) announced that its subsidiary PT Ratu Karya signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Perumda Pasar Jaya on 17 September 2026 to develop the Pasar Minggu area in South Jakarta. The project is estimated to require an investment of approximately Rp1 trillion and will include facilities such as kiosks, lofts for micro, small and medium enterprises, residential apartments, a hospital, office buildings, a shopping centre and a food court. Execution will depend on the completion of technical, legal, commercial, financial, licensing and corporate approvals and compliance with applicable regulations. BIKE said further information will be disclosed in accordance with its obligations as a listed company as the project progresses.
